title: Chapter 40: Counter-Encirclement And Suppression (Iv)
content:
Chapter 40: Counter-Encirclement And Suppression (Iv)

1,000 puppies, facing nearly twice as many elite bugbear soldiers, the outcome is doomed based on the experience of many battles.

The puppies cannot win, and will be defeated quickly.

The bugbear soldiers blessed with the power of faith are not only as strong as the puppies, but also as strong and crazy as the puppies in fighting will.

The hydralisk no longer lingers in the battle, and seizes the opportunity to quickly move away.

Not far from the battlefield, nearly a thousand puppies rushed over and guarded the hydralisk. These were the puppies that had just come from the Zerg territory.

The puppies wandering on both wings of the bugbear army also launched a fierce attack on the lizardman army, slowing down the army's advance.

The bugbear priest saw the puppies coming to help, and he scanned the situation on the battlefield again, knowing that today's encirclement plan was a complete failure.

They underestimated this hidden enemy, and therefore paid a heavy price.

He could feel that the scouts near the battlefield had disappeared, and the enemy's control over this area was tighter than he had imagined.

He couldn't guess what other means the enemy had. Just based on the comparison of the strength of the two sides on the battlefield, it was impossible for them to win.

Now he had to consider how to bring back as many troops as possible and bring back the enemy information he had learned.

After hesitating for a long time, he still took out a special flare. After it was detonated, a signal light of a special color shot up into the sky.

Once this flare was fired, it proved his failure and incompetence, but if he didn't send a signal to request a response, he was afraid that he would not be able to go back today.

Seeing this special flare, the bear goblin city sent out troops again, this time all of them were elite bear goblin soldiers, and there was also an organized cavalry unit.

Seeing this unit, Wu Qing knew that it was impossible to win a complete victory today.

On the battlefield, as the puppies that blocked the bear goblin soldiers quickly died, the hydralisk, which had retreated to a safe distance and was protected by the new puppies, launched a long-range attack on the bear goblin soldiers again.

When all the blocking puppies were killed, the charging bear goblin soldiers had been reduced by nearly half.

These bear goblin soldiers would almost all be killed if they attacked the hydralisk again.

They could no longer threaten the hydralisk, so the bear goblin priest ordered them to retreat to their camp.

If the enemy retreated, of course they had to chase them, which was the essence of the kite tactic.

The hydralisk took the puppies and followed the retreating bear goblin soldiers and shot them all the way.

Of the 2,000 bear goblin soldiers who attacked, only about a quarter of them finally returned safely to their camp.

The puppies fighting on both wings of the enemy army once again killed their way out of the lizardmen's army and continued to threaten the bear goblin army on both wings.

At this time, the number of soldiers in the bear goblin army was less than 10,000.

"Form a circular formation! Hold on and wait for help!"

Under the order of the bear goblin priest, the bear goblin army began to change, forming a nearly circular defensive formation.

The soldiers in the front row facing the hydralisk began to focus on defense to reduce damage.

The other soldiers in the formation threw stones at the Zerg within their range of attack. No matter how effective this attack was, it was better than standing there and passively taking a beating.

The Bugbear reinforcements that came this time were very fast.

Wu Qing tried to use the puppies to attack the Bugbear's circle formation, but found that he did not gain much, so he stopped using the puppies.

Only 400 Hydralisks were used to engage in long-range attack battles with the enemy.

It didn't matter if the Zerg was injured. They would recover after returning to the Zerg territory or resting underground for a while.

Not long after, the Bugbear cavalry arrived first. These cavalry should have received powerful blessings in the city, and their speed was very fast. The Hydralisks wanted to continue to play the kite-flying tactics in front of them, but it would not work.

Using the puppies to besiege these cavalry, when the number advantage was not large, the benefits that could be obtained were limited, so there was no need for this.

As the Bugbear reinforcements arrived one after another, the Zerg troops slowly withdrew from the battle and distanced the two sides.

"Master Priest!"

The general of the bear goblin cavalry came to the bear goblin priest.

"Did the high priest convey any orders?"

"No, we will all obey the orders of the high priest!"

"Then you lead the cavalry to cover the rear, and we will prepare the army and withdraw to the city now!"

"Yes! Master Priest!"

This mighty bear goblin cavalry general led the troops to cover the rear without hesitation.

After the two forces joined together, the army of the bear goblin tribe grew stronger again, and its strength increased sharply. If they really had to fight head-on, the Zerg would definitely not be their opponent.

But the bear goblin priest knew in his heart that this mysterious enemy basically did not play by the rules when fighting, and had many means. If he continued to entangle, he would not get any benefits except losing more troops.

In this case, it would be better to retreat continuously and wait until a countermeasure was developed before deciding the outcome.

In this way, the Zerg troops escorted the army of the bear goblin tribe all the way and slowly moved towards the direction of the bear goblin city.

Only after watching the huge army enter the city did they slowly retreat.

Until this moment, this war of encirclement and counter-encirclement was officially over.

It was initiated by the Bugbears and ended by the Bugbears.

Of course, this was only the first battle between the two sides. It is certain that a bigger battle will come soon.

The Zerg troops reorganized and returned to the battlefields just now, and began to escort the worker bees who came to clean up the battlefields.

Now the Great Xia Territory is in ruins, and all the materials left by the bugbears must be moved back.

All the worker bees of the Zerg temporarily put down their work and came to clean up the battlefield. They must complete the cleaning before dark.

Otherwise, if the battlefield is left overnight in the night when the weirdness is rampant, who knows what will happen.

Wu Qing counted the harvest. This time, a total of about lizardmen and bugbears were killed. The energy and gas resources of the system reached an unprecedented amount.

He increased the number of mother nests in the Zerg territory to 50, so that they can quickly increase the troops when needed.

In the Zerg second base underground in the new city of the Great Xia Territory, the number of mother nests has also increased to 5 to meet the needs of the Great Xia Territory.

This time, a large amount of gas resources were harvested. He plans to increase the number of hydralisks to 1,000. In the future, the backbone of the Zerg combat forces will be hydralisks.

As for the number of puppies, temporarily gather 6,000. When necessary, the number of puppies can be quickly increased.

Hosts continued to increase under the control of the Queen. They were the key to controlling the Zerg and strengthening the collective consciousness of the Zerg. If there was no shortage of energy, the more the better.

After this battle, the Zerg grew rapidly again.

The Zerg is a race that grows in battle!
